business_summary: Shanghai Hi-Road Food Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of baking, catering, and other food raw materials in China and internationally. The company's products include cream series, jam series, chocolate series, edible oil products, compound seasoning sauce, premix series, catering series, and walrus food ingredients. It also offers baking, catering, and home banking industry solutions. In addition, it offers dairy fat-containing non-dairy cream, non-dairy cream, whipped cream, vegetable-based cream, toppings, cake fillings, vegetable protein drinks, plant-based protein drinks, jam, chocolate, and oils and fats. Further, the company is involved in the production and sales of flavors and fragrances and other products; and the import, export, and storage of food from overseas business partners; food raw materials; and goods distribution and application services. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
